title: Cyberpunk Universal Hands VR
creator: natpoh10
licence: MIT for the pinned GitHub source; Nexus package and external dependencies retain their own terms
rights_boundary: MIT-covered GitHub source may be inspected and adapted with attribution. Nexus-hosted packages, BodyWalkVR and other dependencies remain separately governed.
evidence_role: Operational and interface evidence for transport-neutral hand tracking through bounded shared memory, full-arm IK, calibration, persistent offsets and head-relative pose handling.
known_boundaries: The advertised open-source status is now resolved to the MIT-licensed natpoh/cp2077-universal-hands repository at the pinned commit.
The source consumes tracking from BodyWalkVR, OpenXR, SteamVR or custom producers through a shared-memory contract.
The package depends on RED4ext, Cyber Engine Tweaks and Mod Settings.
No Quest 3 Air Link acceptance has been performed by Stephanos.
promotion_rule: Promote the shared-memory pose contract and calibration concepts as derived methods only. Require exact source, licence and local runtime proof before code reuse or acceptance.
